findings.title: Linter fails on its own package
findings.evidence: Fixed: the scan skips SELF while still scanning every other script. R1 exits 0 with PASS; R10 proves a copied extract_pdf.py is still flagged.

findings.title: Re-run into same out-dir exits 2
findings.evidence: Run 2 same --out exits 2; --force exits 0. Disclosed in v2 section 4.8.
findings.impact: Fail-closed; no data loss. UX only.
findings.recommendation: Keep; optionally add unique run directories.

findings.title: Six regression tests named in v2 docs do not exist
findings.evidence: Fixed: all six tests exist and pass in R2 (60 passed): test_lint_requires_authorisation_gate, test_report_truncation_notice, test_interval_complex_errors, test_timeout_fails_closed, test_provenance_present, test_force_overwrites.
findings.impact: Documented QA coverage is now guarded.

findings.title: Residual DoS surface in safe_expr
findings.evidence: Fixed for allocation vectors: MAX_MATRIX_DIM=64, MAX_INT_ARG=10000 and MAX_SEQ=4096. R7 rejects eye(65), zeros(65,65), ones(65,1), Matrix(65,1,[0]), factorial(10001), binomial(10001,2), gamma(10001), diag(eye(64),eye(64)), [0]*4097, Matrix([0]*65), Matrix([[0]*65]*65), Matrix(64,64,[0]*4097); R8 accepts the bounded forms. integrate/limit/solve remain under the trusted-input model plus per-check SIGALRM timeout; no true OOM/hang was induced.
findings.impact: Memory-exhaustion vectors are capped; CPU-heavy calls are timeout-bounded.
findings.recommendation: Applied: caps in safe_expr.py; references/tool-safety.md rule 2 documents the caps and timeout model.

findings.title: Broken-local-link check is vacuous
findings.evidence: SKILL.md paths are code spans, not markdown links; only the hardcoded REQUIRED list guards existence.
findings.impact: Linter cannot detect broken relative links.
findings.recommendation: Parse markdown links, or drop the claim.

findings.title: Packaging contradicts v1 rules
findings.evidence: samples/ (1.1 MB PDF) and docs/ ship inside the skill; v1 says keep the eval suite outside the skill folder and no auxiliary docs.
findings.impact: Packaging rule is violated without disclosure.
findings.recommendation: Declare the exception in SKILL.md, or move audit artefacts to repo docs/.

findings.title: Verification playbook lost content
findings.evidence: Shipped playbook is 32 lines; v1 had universal checks 1-7, executable JSON example, SymPy patterns, and a probability row.
findings.impact: Weaker G4 guidance for topics outside the Q6 example.
findings.recommendation: Restore them compactly while keeping the v2 suite contract.

findings.title: --pages accepts garbage and tracebacks
findings.evidence: --pages abc exits 1 with an uncaught ValueError traceback instead of exit 2.
findings.impact: Violates the documented usage/config exit-code contract.
findings.recommendation: Use an argparse type or catch ValueError and exit 2; reject non-positive and out-of-range pages.

findings.title: Textless PDF still fails open (hypothesis)
findings.evidence: --pages 999 yields pages=0, G0 FAILED, exit 3; test_textless_pdf_exit3 passes.

findings.title: Wrong rejection message for huge exponents
findings.evidence: 2**100000 is rejected as 'non-finite exponent' because UnsafeExpression subclasses ValueError and is caught by its own except ValueError.
findings.impact: Fails closed, but the message misdiagnoses the cause.
findings.recommendation: Re-raise UnsafeExpression before the generic ValueError catch.

findings.title: Config-class malformed expressions report as maths ERROR
findings.evidence: expr [1,2] and expr I produce ERROR rows and exit 1, not config exit 2.
findings.impact: Blurs config vs maths failure semantics.
findings.recommendation: Validate result type (Expr/Matrix) and raise ConfigError.

findings.title: SKILL.md file tree is incomplete
findings.evidence: Tree omits samples/ and docs/ that ship.
findings.recommendation: Add them, or move docs/ out and document the sample fixture.

findings.title: v2 promotion commands are partly wrong
findings.evidence: After revision 2, '# expect PASS' and '# expect all pass' are true (R1/R2) and PART 6's 'Linter would PASS' is true; ../../samples still resolves outside the skill.
findings.impact: The only remaining defect is the sample path; a reviewer can otherwise reach Verified.

findings.title: Distinct Deduce obligation dropped
findings.evidence: v2 merges 'Hence / Deduce'; v1 had a distinct Deduce row.
findings.impact: One command-word obligation is no longer explicit.

findings.title: Exemplar provenance over-claim
findings.evidence: Handoff claims 'Verified: 7/7 exact checks' while section 5 says 'no CAS ... executed'; ledger omits checks_sha256/tool version required by the solution template.
findings.impact: Weakens the exemplar as a conformance reference.
findings.recommendation: Say '7/7 via assets/checks.example.json (executed)' or 'hand-checked'; add checks_sha256 N/A with reason.
